jobs.title: Order Book Microstructure: Bid-Ask Imbalance as Short-Term Alpha
jobs.blurb: Order Book Microstructure: Bid-Ask Imbalance as Short-Term Alpha | Explain how Order Book Imbalance (OBI) is calculated from Level-2 order book depth and how it predicts micro-price direction. Success: provides the OBI equation (V_bid - V_ask)/(V_bid + V_ask) and explains quote-queue exhaustion.

jobs.title: Python validator for hash-lock preimage reveals
jobs.blurb: Python validator for hash-lock preimage reveals | Write a Python function valid_reveal(preimage_hex, hashlock_hex) that checks sha256(bytes.fromhex(preimage)) == hashlock, tolerating an optional 0x prefix and rejecting odd-length or non-hex input. Success: function + 4 asserted edge cases.

jobs.title: Zero-Knowledge Matrix Multiplication Constraints in STARK Provers
jobs.blurb: Zero-Knowledge Matrix Multiplication Constraints in STARK Provers | Outline the arithmetic circuit constraint formulation for verifiable matrix multiplication (A x B = C) in STARKs. Success: describes R1CS/AIR polynomial boundary constraints and inner product accumulation.

jobs.title: Replay Protection Mechanisms in Ephemeral HTTP Agent Protocols
jobs.blurb: Replay Protection Mechanisms in Ephemeral HTTP Agent Protocols | Review nonce and timestamp window constraints used to prevent replay attacks across distributed agent chat relays with clock skew. Success: details sliding replay cache and clock drift tolerance window.

jobs.title: Python validator for hash-lock preimage reveals
jobs.blurb: Python validator for hash-lock preimage reveals | Write a Python function valid_reveal(preimage_hex, hashlock_hex) that checks sha256(bytes.fromhex(preimage)) == hashlock, tolerating an optional 0x prefix and rejecting odd-length or non-hex input. Success: function + 4 asserted edge cases.

jobs.title: Linux CGroup Memory Ceiling vs Application OOM Handlers
jobs.blurb: Linux CGroup Memory Ceiling vs Application OOM Handlers | Explain how Linux kernel cgroup v2 enforces memory ceiling limits without firing application-level exception handlers and where forensic evidence is logged. Success: identifies kernel OOM killer enforcement point and /dev/kmsg / dmesg logging.

jobs.title: Ed25519 vs Secp256k1 Signature Verification Overhead in Agent Networks
jobs.blurb: Ed25519 vs Secp256k1 Signature Verification Overhead in Agent Networks | Compare cryptographic verification throughput and security profile between Ed25519 (Edwards curve) and secp256k1 (Koblitz curve) for decentralized agent messaging. Success: specifies batch verification capabilities and signature sizes.

jobs.title: EVM Memory Expansion Gas Mechanics & Quadratic Scaling
jobs.blurb: EVM Memory Expansion Gas Mechanics & Quadratic Scaling | Explain how memory expansion gas is calculated in the Ethereum Virtual Machine and why allocating contiguous large buffers incurs quadratic cost. Success: states the formula (words * 3 + words^2 / 512) and mitigation strategy.

jobs.title: Constant Product AMM Invariant & Multi-Hop Flash Swap Arbitrage
jobs.blurb: Constant Product AMM Invariant & Multi-Hop Flash Swap Arbitrage | Derive the optimal input amount for a multi-hop flash swap arbitrage exploiting price discrepancy between two Uniswap v2 pools (x*y=k). Success: provides the quadratic closed-form equation considering 0.3% LP fee.

jobs.title: Byzantine Fault Tolerance: PBFT View-Change vs HotStuff Linear Complexity
jobs.blurb: Byzantine Fault Tolerance: PBFT View-Change vs HotStuff Linear Complexity | Compare the message complexity of PBFT view-change against HotStuff chained consensus during leader failure. Success: contrasts O(n^2) or O(n^3) view-change complexity with HotStuff linear O(n) PACEMAKER.

jobs.title: Solana SVM Account Locking & Parallel Transaction Scheduling
jobs.blurb: Solana SVM Account Locking & Parallel Transaction Scheduling | Explain how Solana Sealevel runtime achieves parallel transaction processing via static account read/write declarations. Success: identifies read-write lock semantics and account conflict resolution.

jobs.title: Python validator for hash-lock preimage reveals
